Class Condition

java.lang.Object
gate.sql.condition.Condition
All Implemented Interfaces:
Clause
Direct Known Subclasses:
CompiledCondition, ConstantCondition, ExtractorCondition
public abstract class Condition extends Object implements Clause
A condition to be used on SQL select, update and delete statements.

A Condition is a list of Predicate associated by Relation
